issue.body:
I thought the way of detecting keywords is the same in [space-before-keywords](http://eslint.org/docs/rules/space-before-keywords) and [space-after-keywords](http://eslint.org/docs/rules/space-after-keywords), so I made an idea that merges two.
This rule is similar to [semi-spacing](http://eslint.org/docs/rules/semi-spacing), [comma-spacing](http://eslint.org/docs/rules/comma-spacing), and [arrow-spacing](http://eslint.org/docs/rules/arrow-spacing).

``` js
{
    "keyword-spacing": [2, {"before": true, "after": true}]
}
```

**Note:**
- Should check only spacing which is preceded by a closing parenthesis (`)`, `]`, `}`) and spacing which is followed by a opening parenthesis (`(`, `[`, `{`). This is to avoid conflicts with [semi-spacing](http://eslint.org/docs/rules/semi-spacing), [comma-spacing](http://eslint.org/docs/rules/comma-spacing), [arrow-spacing](http://eslint.org/docs/rules/arrow-spacing), [space-in-parens](http://eslint.org/docs/rules/space-in-parens), [array-bracket-spacing](http://eslint.org/docs/rules/array-bracket-spacing), [object-curly-spacing](http://eslint.org/docs/rules/object-curly-spacing), [block-spacing](http://eslint.org/docs/rules/block-spacing), [space-infix-ops](http://eslint.org/docs/rules/space-infix-ops), and [key-spacing](http://eslint.org/docs/rules/key-spacing).
- Should ignore spacing which is preceded by `function`, `return`, `throw`, `case`, `new`, `delete`, `typeof`, `void`, or `yield`. It's checked by [space-before-function-paren](http://eslint.org/docs/rules/space-before-function-paren), [space-return-throw-case](http://eslint.org/docs/rules/space-return-throw-case), and  [space-unary-ops](http://eslint.org/docs/rules/space-unary-ops).
- Should ignore spacing which is between `super` and `(`. It's checked by [no-spaced-func](http://eslint.org/docs/rules/no-spaced-func).

Perhaps [space-return-throw-case](http://eslint.org/docs/rules/space-return-throw-case) can be merged if there is an `overrides` option that is similar to [operator-linebreak](http://eslint.org/docs/rules/operator-linebreak)'s.

Original rules are marked deprecated and will be removed at 2.0.0.

---

Could I get your opinion?

I'm happy to work on this if accepted.

issue.body:
The following code throws with `space-before-keywords: [2, "always"]` enabled:

``` javascript
(super.componentWillMount || noop)(...arguments);
```

Error thrown:
`Missing space before keyword "super". (space-before-keyword)`

I think `super` keyword in ES6 could be considered as a "normal" variable, so this rule kind of breaks on normal use cases.

ESLint version: `v1.5.0`
